OMNIVORE.protein: Aim for 2.0–2.4g protein per kg of bodyweight to preserve muscle.
meals: Breakfast: 3 egg whites + 1 whole egg + oats (40g) + black coffee
Lunch: 150g grilled chicken breast + large salad + olive oil dressing
Snack: Greek yogurt (0% fat) + 1 handful almonds
Dinner: 150g white fish + steamed broccoli + 100g sweet potato
Pre-bed: 1 scoop casein protein + water

VEGAN.calories: Eat 300–500 kcal below maintenance. Track carefully as plant foods are filling.
VEGAN.protein: Aim for 1.8–2.2g protein per kg. Combine complementary proteins.
meals: Breakfast: Tofu scramble (150g) + spinach + nutritional yeast + black coffee
Lunch: Lentil soup + quinoa (100g cooked) + side salad
Snack: Edamame (100g) + rice cakes
Dinner: Tempeh stir-fry (150g) + broccoli + soy sauce + brown rice (100g)
Pre-bed: Pea protein shake (25g protein)

OMNIVORE.calories: Eat 300–500 kcal above maintenance. Aim for lean bulking to minimize fat gain.
OMNIVORE.protein: Aim for 1.8–2.2g protein per kg. Carbs are your friend for energy.
meals: Breakfast: 4 whole eggs scrambled + 2 slices sourdough + 250ml whole milk
Lunch: 200g beef mince (90% lean) + rice (200g cooked) + vegetables
Post-Workout: 50g oats + 2 bananas + 1 scoop whey protein
Dinner: 200g salmon + pasta (200g cooked) + olive oil + vegetables
Snack: Peanut butter (30g) + 2 rice cakes + 1 banana

OMNIVORE.calories: Eat at or very close to maintenance calories. High protein is critical.
OMNIVORE.protein: Aim for 2.2–2.6g protein per kg — the highest of all phases.
meals: Breakfast: Overnight oats (60g) + chia seeds + whey protein + berries
Lunch: 180g turkey breast + sweet potato (150g) + asparagus
Snack: Cottage cheese (200g) + walnuts (20g)
Dinner: 180g cod + green beans + quinoa (100g cooked)
Pre-bed: 1 scoop casein + small handful mixed nuts
